<p align="left"><font size="2" face="serif">      In connection with the Quarterly
    Report of Brandywine Operating Partnership, L.P. (the &#8220;Partnership&#8221;)
    on Form 10-Q for the quarter ended September 30, 2004 as filed with the Securities
    and Exchange Commission on the date hereof (the &#8220;Report&#8221;), I,
    Christopher P. Marr, Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of
    Brandywine Realty Trust, the Partnership&#8217;s General Partner, certify,
    pursuant to 18 U.S.C. Section 1350, as adopted pursuant to Section 906 of
    the Sarbanes-Oxley
    Act
    of 2002,
    that: </font></p>

<tr valign="top">
<td width="3%"><font size="2" face="serif">  1.  </font></td>

</tr>
</table>

<tr valign="top">
